behavior: One chain whose RPC hosts are down no longer stops the api, worker and signer: that chain waits until two hosts answer again, and the other chains keep working
acceptance: When an enabled chain's RPC hosts don't answer at startup (fewer than two answer), the api, worker and signer log that chain as unavailable and start, as they already keep running through an outage; nothing is decided paid or settled without the second RPC (D-15), as before. Both roles are asked at once, so a role is checked even when the other is down

A mistake in the chain list or on chain still stops them: a chain missing from the list, a chain listing one host, a role whose hosts all serve another chain, no factory code, or an executor without gas
The startup factory check (address.FactoryDeployed) and the signer's gas check (settlement.CheckGas) ask the second RPC when the primary fails, instead of stopping on the primary's error

2026-10-22 review fail by reviewer: settlement.CheckGas moves to the next RPC on any error, a shortfall included, so a primary that reports the executor below MinGas is overridden by a second that shows enough (reproduced via an overlay test: real primary at 1 wei plus a Stale proxy returning 1 ETH for eth_getBalance gives nil). This goes past accept 3 (ask the second only when the primary's read fails), weakens accept 2 (an executor without gas stops) and differs from FactoryDeployed, which stops on the first definite 'no code'; when the second then errors, its read error also replaces the 'fund it' message. Fix: continue only on read errors, stop on the first shortfall, and add that case to TestCheckGas. The rest holds: both roles run in parallel without races, the new TestCheckEnabled case fails on the previous check.go, factory/gas tests fail on primary-only code, no key in the warning, every new doc sentence is 25 words or fewer.

2026-10-22 review pass by reviewer: Pass: startup skips a chain only when both roles, asked at once, fail while each still has a host not found on another chain; every listed mistake stops; FactoryDeployed and CheckGas go to the second RPC only on a failed read, both shortfall paths wrap errFundIt, no key reaches the warning or errors, and chain/address/settlement tests pass with -race.
